result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: the bottom navigation is overlapped by a black bar obscuring its middle icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is obscured by a thick black horizontal bar that cuts across its center, covering and making the middle navigation icons (search and orders/bookmark) barely visible and unusable, while only the Home and Profile icons at the edges remain clear.
issues.suggestion: Fix safe-area/bottom inset handling so the system home indicator does not overlap the navigation content. Add bottom padding to the navigation bar, move the indicator below/above it as intended, and ensure all navigation icons are fully visible and tappable.
